name: astrolabe
description: Spec Kit progress and usage governance for Claude Code: a phase rail above the prompt, the next command in the prompt hint, the current task on the spinner, a /astrolabe pane, toasts, update buttons, and a status entry with your usage window.

preset.title: Preset
preset.description: Where Astrolabe draws: minimal (status line only), compact (status, band, hint, spinner and the drift alarm) or full (compact plus phase toasts and the pane opening by itself on wide screens)

flavor.title: Flavor
flavor.description: Catppuccin flavor for the band colors, or theme to follow Claude Code's light and dark theme

checkUpdates.title: Check for updates
checkUpdates.description: Once a day, check gstack, the Spec Kit CLI, this project's Spec Kit skills and Astrolabe for updates (one GitHub API call), and offer a button to install each

governUsage.title: Govern usage
governUsage.description: Keep subagent fan-out under the 5-hour and weekly windows: cap at 60%, hold new subagents from 80%, pause from 88% and resume after the reset

icons.title: Icons
icons.description: Icons in the footer, band and pane: auto (Nerd Font glyphs in the terminal, emoji in the Desktop app and elsewhere), nerd, emoji or ascii

language.title: Language
language.description: The language of the pane, the Dashboard, the questions, the toasts and the help: auto (the language you type in), en, pt-BR, es or fr

askOnLimit.title: Ask before holding or pausing
askOnLimit.description: When the governor queues a subagent or pauses Claude, ask you with a list of answers (queue, run now, lift for a while); the cautious default applies at once, and your answer changes it

claudeContext.title: Tell Claude about the Spec Kit work
claudeContext.description: Add one line on the active feature, its current task and the next command to your prompt when it changed, and the constitution's principles when a Spec Kit skill runs

featureSummary.title: Summary when a feature finishes
featureSummary.description: When a feature's tasks are all done, ask a small model (haiku) for a five-line summary, shown in the Session tab; it uses a little of your usage

humanize.title: Write like a person
humanize.description: Add short humanizer rules to Claude's system prompt: plain prose, no hype words, no em dashes, facts kept exact

terse.title: Terse answers
terse.description: Ask Claude to answer briefly: lite keeps full sentences, full drops filler and articles; files and commits stay normal prose

skillModels.title: Model per skill
skillModels.description: auto sends each Spec Kit and gstack skill's requests with the model and effort it does best with (see the Help tab); switching models re-reads the context, so it costs more on long sessions

accessible.title: Accessible mode
accessible.description: Text only: ASCII icons, charts as text, no hover styles, no animation and no pictures, for screen readers and plain terminals

footerIn.title: Where the footer goes
footerIn.description: pane: the bottom of the /astrolabe pane under every tab, the status entry keeping the Spec Kit part and the deciding window; status: the whole footer in the status entry; both

autoReload.title: Reload when a new version lands on disk
autoReload.description: After a turn, when the Astrolabe on disk is newer than the one running (a local clone, an update), run /reload-plugins once; off, a toast says to run it

images.title: Pictures in the Dashboard
images.description: Draw the usage chart as a picture: auto on kitty and Ghostty outside tmux, on for any terminal that shows pictures (iTerm2, WezTerm), off for cell charts

pullRequest.title: Pull request in the footer
pullRequest.description: Show the branch's open pull request and its checks in the footer, from the gh command, asked at most once every five minutes

bandDensity.title: How much the band shows
bandDensity.description: full: the rail with every step name when there is room; compact: the current step and the count; minimal: the feature id and its step
